notes: Stock-only Warehouse In / Out Ledger + unit normalization. Excludes Non-stock / Customer Order and Record Only business lines from inventory-flow totals; excludes physical-count corrections from receiving/shipping flow; keeps completed Carpet Cutting and Stock Order Picking as outbound and uses actual carpet stock deduction including 3-inch allowance/full-roll finish. Current Month/Half-Year/Inventory-Year summaries are cumulative only through today, so future-dated records are not counted early. Box and Carton are normalized to the single inventory/reporting unit Box. Inventory-posted Receiving rows must pass Product Identity and strict Roll-program unit guards. Piece remains valid for genuine sheet/plywood stock; Tube remains available for non-stock business records but is excluded from the Stock ledger.
